clues: This city spreads along a wide bay of the sea. A flat plain and tall peaks lie close round it on land.
The sea keeps this city's heat and cold from going too far. Most rain falls in the cool months, from fall to spring.
This city was founded in the year 972, long, long ago. Yet a trade town stood here much, much earlier still.
Folk call this city 'the White' for its bright white homes. Its whitewashed walls shine in the sun by the sea.
This is the largest town in Algeria and the seat of its rule. The men and women who lead the land work from here.
